kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنصرم (form VII)
# أَنْصَرِمُ (ʔanṣarimu) /ʔan.sˤa.ri.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# أَنْصَرِمَ (ʔanṣarima) /ʔan.sˤa.ri.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# أَنْصَرِمْ (ʔanṣarim) /ʔan.sˤa.rim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
